 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 03-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Sikarhatta P.S. Case No. 49 of 2014 registered for the offence under Sections 498A, 323, 379, 504, 494 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and others are said to have tortured the victim for demand of dowry.
4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is the husband of the victim and he is in jail since 24.06.2024.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts, this application Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66306 of 2024(2) dt.03-10-2024 is allowed.
